scope: new isolated engineering only; historical P/D/B parameters unchanged

cherry_tomato_TA.commodity: fully ripe cherry tomato; paper storage conditions
cherry_tomato_TA.location: Abstract; section 2.5.1 equations 2-5; section 3.3.2 Table 2 TA row
cherry_tomato_TA.rate_evidence: published fitted expression, not direct 18C measurement
cherry_tomato_TA.paper_typography_note: Table T column lists temperatures, not reaction order. Ea heading kg/mol and inverted-time sign conflict with physical units and decreasing kinetics; use positive Ea in J/mol, positive k, and equation 2 decay. lnA=4.65 is the reported expression; tabulated A=104.58 is rounded.
cherry_tomato_TA.limitations: TA is one nutrient proxy, not total freshness, saleability or food safety. Piecewise dynamic integration extends an isothermal storage fit. No arbitrary saleability threshold added.

chilled_mullet_overall_impression.commodity: aerobically stored Mugil cephalus slices, 50g; no vacuum packaging
chilled_mullet_overall_impression.rate_evidence: published fitted mean; score points/day, not fractional rate
chilled_mullet_overall_impression.limitations: Caller supplies initial score. Threshold 5 is sensory rejection only; this evaluator does not model microbes or histamine. Standard errors retained as metadata, not an outcome CI.

frozen_seabass_overall_acceptability_sce.commodity: vacuum packed frozen Dicentrarchus labrax fillets, 90 plus/minus 10g
frozen_seabass_overall_acceptability_sce.location: equation 5; section 3.3; Table 1 overall acceptability Ea; Table 4 shelf life
frozen_seabass_overall_acceptability_sce.rate_evidence: scenario-derived 4/133 score points/day; published shelf life 133 days at -5C plus explicit assumed initial score 9. Not an exact recovered fitted intercept/rate.
frozen_seabass_overall_acceptability_sce.limitations: 9-to-5 rate derivation is a simulation assumption. Direct paper fitted kref/intercept is not recovered. -18C is outside experimental range and rejected unless explicit extrapolation. Never label 600 days or 4/600/24 as the paper's exact rate.
